calculation_handling.description: A parking space inside a building (not an ancillary building) on an RM lot may be converted to interior floor area for a use under 10.80.20.100(21) or (22), with no replacement parking, if it is in a residential building other than an apartment building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Building types: "any" because the clause names only an exclusion (other than an apartment building); the exclusion is not expressible as a token. Depends on an existing in-building parking space.

units.disclosure: Converting an indoor parking space to a permitted non-residential use (without replacing the parking) is allowed under conditions we do not evaluate.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion: the vehicle entrance to the parking space is in the front main wall of the building.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion: the driveway leading to the vehicle entrance is removed and any front-yard depression is filled to established grade.
calculation_handling.gaps: No vocab.requirement token covers driveway removal and regrading, so the obligation is keyed UNUSUAL (conservative) rather than REQUIRE.

10.80.80.1(1).explanation: In the RM zone, an indoor parking space in a house (not an apartment building) may be turned into floor area for certain permitted non-residential uses without providing replacement parking, if the garage door is in the front wall, the driveway is removed and landscaped, and any front or side-street yard parking meets 10.5.80.10(3) or gets a minor variance.
